obs: "In construing those provisions, however, we have held that no weight can be given to the suggestion that they must be interpreted on the premise that their enactment was in part motivated by a congressional desire to suppress wagering."

“We reach our conclusions without relying on the finding made by the court below that in 131-a New York was attempting to constrict its welfare payments. Speculation as to legislative and executive motive is to be shunned.”
